summary: Function: A digital platform and narrative-driven storytelling medium centered on the Mars Exploration Rovers, Spirit and Opportunity.   Impact: Preserves mission logs and geological discoveries while shifting focus toward the philosophical and historical meaning of space exploration.   Development: Built using web technologies and hosted on Netlify, drawing directly from official NASA mission archives.   Design: Frames scientific data as an atmospheric mystery, balancing exact findings with a reflective narrative tone.
details:
• What it does & how it works: The platform acts as a digital archive and interactive storytelling medium centered on the Mars Exploration Rovers, guiding visitors through the historical discoveries and geological findings of Spirit and Opportunity.
  • Benefits & Impact: It preserves and translates dense scientific logs into an engaging, narrative-driven experience, shifting the focus from raw data to the philosophical and historical implications of planetary exploration.
  • Tech stack & tools: Built using standard web development languages and hosted via Netlify, drawing directly from official NASA mission archives and science highlights.
  • Creativity & factors considered: Rather than presenting a dry chronological report, the project frames interplanetary data as an atmospheric mystery, balancing precise scientific findings with a reflective, human-centered narrative tone.
dataRefs: i used https://science.nasa.gov/mission/mars-exploration-rovers-spirit-and-opportunity/, wikipedia and some images uploaded by nasa
